inquiry: Hello - my wife and I would like four nights somewhere beautiful in northern Pakistan in late September. We want comfortable hotels, good food, and not much driving. Money is not a constraint. We are American.

brief.notes: No budget stated; premium tier appropriate

notes: Short, unconstrained by budget, explicitly low-effort. Tests that the system does not over-pack a trip just because it can, and that an absent budget does not default to the cheapest option.
